news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 27%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2027 has deteriorated. 2027 revenue forecast decreased from ₹21.2b to ₹19.6b. EPS estimate also fell from ₹45.03 per share to ₹33.07 per share. Net income forecast to grow 56% next year vs 21% growth forecast for Machinery industry in India. Consensus price target down from ₹2,020 to ₹1,931. Share price rose 4.6% to ₹1,848 over the past week.

news.body: An unknown funds managed by Apollo Management Singapore Pte. Ltd. and Tega Industries Limited (NSEI:TEGA) entered into a term sheet to acquire AIP MC Holdings LLC from AIP, LLC for an enterprise value $1.5 billion of on September 10, 2025. A cash consideration will be paid by Apollo Management Singapore Pte. Ltd. and Tega Industries Limited. The upfront consideration was determined on the basis of a “locked box” approach, based on the unaudited balance sheet of Molycop as of June 30, 2025. The upfront consideration will be subject to customary adjustment as per the terms to be agreed in the Purchase Agreement. news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹20.54 (down from ₹30.08 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹17.7b (up 8.2% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹1.43b (down 29% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 8.0% (down from 12% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 5.4%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 33%. Revenue is forecast to grow 16% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 12% growth forecast for the Machinery industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has remained flat but the company’s share price has increased by 27% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.body: The Board of Directors of Tega Industries Limited have also considered and recommended Final Dividend of INR 2 per equity share (20%) of face value of INR 10/- each for the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026, subject to declaration of the same by the Members at the 50th Annual General Meeting (AGM) of the Company to be convened on September 24, 2026. The Record Date for the purpose of ascertaining the entitlement of Members to the Final Dividend for the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026, has been fixed as September 14, 2026.

news.title: TEGA: Stable Fair Value And Board Actions Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Tega Industries steady at ₹2,083.67 per share, with only marginal tweaks to inputs like the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E. This reflects a broadly unchanged overall view of the company.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.83 (vs ₹8.15 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.83 (down from ₹8.15 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹4.18b (up 2.0% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹197.1m (down 64% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.7% (down from 13% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 18% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Machinery industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 7% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 37% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
